title: The Summer Book
description: One summer on an island in a pale northern sea: a grandmother who is getting old and a six-year-old girl who lost her mother this spring. Before the summer ends the grandmother can give her one thing — the truth, protection, or the summer itself. What will she give, and what will be left ungiven?
line: An island for one summer, an old woman and a little girl — and what will Grandmother have time to give her?
source: after the novel by Tove Jansson
